name: q-darkstore
prompt: A slow dolly forward down an aisle of a quick-commerce dark store in an Indian city at night: grey metal shelves of packaged groceries and plain brown cartons under cool white tube lights. A young picker in a dark vest and cap scans a plain brown carton on a trolley with a handheld scanner; the scanner's small screen flashes red and he sets the carton aside and moves on to the next shelf. Other pickers pass at the far end of the aisle pushing trolleys. Photorealistic cinematic footage, natural motion. Audio: the hum of a large cold room, scanner beeps, trolley wheels, distant footsteps, no music, no voices.
